structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of at least 11 tokens all called "Untaxed App" (UNTXD) launched on Solana within about 30 minutes (roughly 23:52–00:22 UTC). They borrow the name of Untaxed Wallet, a real zero-fee Solana trading wallet (untaxed.wtf, @UntaxedSolana). The project's own site and links page name only one contract: 3tzkdxJ1qVCaPAuWmd8FjRFKUbwMYpLUAq5gg4Vopump. That token appears in the packet as UNTXD, sitting at about $74–78k market cap. CERMY… is not the listed contract. It is a Token-2022 token from a Meteora virtual-curve launch, created and migrated in the same second, which points to a direct pool setup. It was pumped to about $770–790k market cap with about $80k of liquidity on PumpSwap. Among the clones, 9v93… has more liquidity ($289k) and a higher market cap ($964k). The official project attracts real attention, but this particular contract has no claim to it.

narrative.description: Untaxed Wallet is a real product: a zero-fee Solana trading wallet and terminal on Chrome, iOS and Android, with a holder-benefit token. The clones feed off attention to what looks like a new or relaunched token from the project, or a buzz event around it.
narrative.why_spreading: A real app with a token-utility story, plus apparent launch buzz, set off a copycat race. Traders are buying whichever same-name contract is moving. I could not see the trigger post on X.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond sharing the name and ticker and borrowing the project's X handle in its metadata. The official website and links page name 3tzkdx…pump as the contract, not CERMY….
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are 10+ same-name tokens. 3tzkdx…pump is the project's listed contract ($78k market cap, $25k liquidity). 9v93… is the biggest clone ($964k market cap, $289k liquidity, $2.3M hourly volume). Several others have already hit zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: This looks like a copycat launch farm: 11 identical-name tokens within minutes, 11 duplicate images, and 51 bundler wallets (13.7% top-bundler trader share). Our contract has 2,094 unique buyers but only 87 unique sellers, which suggests a few wallets are distributing into retail. The creator has launched 3 tokens and has already closed their position. No paid DexScreener promotion was found.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X timeline, so I can't tell whether the official account or any KOLs pointed at this contract.

structural_risks: RugCheck shows 99.99% of LP unlocked (danger flag) and only a few LP providers, so liquidity can be pulled at any time
A single unlabeled holder (FhVo…) has 80.05% of supply. The Pump AMM pool holds only 5.15%, so this is a huge possible overhang unless it turns out to be a pool or locker
Token-2022 token from a Meteora virtual curve, created and migrated in the same second, which suggests a direct pool setup
Liquidity is about $80k against about $790k market cap, and the price is already up about 900% in 40 minutes
It is not the canonical contract; a larger clone and the official contract compete for the same attention

structured_output.counterargument: Copycat tokens sometimes win the market regardless of which contract the project lists. This one has real turnover (2,000+ buyers, $2M+ volume) and is second-largest among the clones. If the Untaxed brand keeps trending, it could go from $0.8M to $1.6M market cap in a 6-hour mania. GMGN reports a 5.5% top-10 holder rate and an LP burn ratio of 1.0, which may mean the 80% holder is a pool or locker and not a dump risk.

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical copycat of the Untaxed Wallet token. It is one of 11+ same-name launches, carries a large bundler share, the creator has already exited, LP is 99.99% unlocked, and an unexplained wallet holds 80% of supply. It is already up about 900% and is not even the largest clone. A liquidity pull or a slow bleed is far more likely than another doubling.
